spine: 1. 既有 VCS 沒有一套同時滿足 content-agnostic、large-on-every-axis、centrally-coordinated 三性質的最大型開發 workload；Lore 的整個架構是對這三性質之間張力的一連串取捨。
2. 一切建在 content-addressed immutable store 上：每個 byte 用 BLAKE3 hash 定址、只存一份，dedup 是寫入路徑的內建性質而非事後 GC；address 是 (hash 32B, context 16B)=48B，context 讓相同 payload 仍能保留不同檔案身分。
3. 大檔靠 chunking 與 FastCDC（average 64 KiB、floor 32 KiB、ceiling 256 KiB）解決『改一 byte 重存整檔』，content-defined 切點讓插入只動少數 chunk；另有 fixed-size 切法，取捨在 canonicality；fragment list 過長會遞迴 chunk。
4. repository 狀態是 Merkle tree（dir hash 由子節點 sorted hash 推導、root hash 唯一定義整庫狀態），revision 是每條 edge 為 cryptographic link 的 DAG；改一檔只重算 root 到該檔路徑、其餘節點同 hash 同 storage entry 零複製。

5. centralized by design（access control/durability/audit/conflict resolution 需單一權威；peer-to-peer 為 non-goal）但 offline-capable；儲存拆成 immutable store（內容、只 append）與 mutable store（pointers/names、consistency/serialization/contention 所在），branch 是 mutable pointer，cas 提供 atomic state transition。
6. client 端靠 sparse（.lore/view inbound filter）+ lazy hydration + byte-range 讀取，只 materialize 用得到的子集；部署有 optional cache and replica tiers。

7. 對照 Git（DVCS、binary 走 LFS out-of-band、sparse 僅 deprecated non-cone）與 Perforce（中央式、需 server round-trip、delta-RCS/full-file、離線 awkward），Lore 取中央 source of truth + 離線能力 + binary-first content-addressed store；但全系統 pre-1.0、無 benchmark、論斷多處需標推斷。

perspective.mechanism: Lore 的對外定位：centralized, content-addressed VCS，repository state 表為 Merkle trees + immutable revision chain，為 binary-first storage、dedup、sparse/on-demand hydration at scale 而最佳化。
perspective.tradeoff: open source (MIT) + tamper-evident 可信歷史，換來中央式取向（非 Git 式去中心生態）。
perspective.reader_use: 台灣工程師評估大型 monorepo / 大量 binary 資產版控時，可把 lore.org 的一句定位當成 profile 對照表的起點。

perspective.mechanism: 文件首頁／導覽：Lore 定位為『designed for unprecedented scalability of both data and teams』的 next-generation open source VCS，並明示 pre-1.0 與 on-disk format 可能變動的警語。
perspective.tradeoff: 前沿能力 vs 介面/格式不穩定（pre-1.0）。
perspective.reader_use: 要不要現在就導入 Lore，pre-1.0 警語是最關鍵的風險訊號。

perspective.mechanism: Explanation 區的入口頁，只含導覽與『Explanation is the why of Lore』一句，實質設計理由全在其下的 system-design 子頁。
perspective.reader_use: 讀者要往 system-design 子頁才拿得到設計細節，此頁僅作路標。

perspective.mechanism: 本文最重要的單一來源：完整描述 content-addressed immutable store、(hash,context) address、BLAKE3、FastCDC/fixed-size chunking 與參數、fragment list 遞迴、Merkle tree、revision DAG、immutable vs mutable store、packfiles、branch/cas、sparse view、byte-range hydration、centralized-but-offline 設計與 non-goals，以及對 Git/Perforce 的比較。
perspective.tradeoff: 把『難而小』的並行 serialization/contention 收進 mutable store 的 cas，把『大而易』的內容攤到無鎖 content-addressed immutable store——規模與競爭分離；FastCDC vs fixed-size 則在 dedup 與 canonicality 間取捨。
perspective.reader_use: 想真的搞懂 Lore 怎麼 scale、要不要押注，這份 system-design 是最該逐段讀的一手文件。

perspective.mechanism: 原始碼倉庫 README：Lore 為『designed for unprecedented scalability of both data and teams』，MIT License，pre-1.0 警語，SDK 語言列表。
perspective.tradeoff: 開源可自審/自架 vs pre-1.0 不穩定。
perspective.reader_use: 確認授權（MIT）、維護者（Epic Games）與 SDK 語言涵蓋是否含自己團隊的技術棧。

notes.quote: Lore is a centralized, content-addressed version control system that represents repository state as Merkle trees and an immutable revision chain, optimized for binary-first storage, deduplication, and sparse/on-demand data hydration at scale.
notes.interpretation: Lore 的一句話定位，本文開頭與整體架構框架的依據。

notes.quote: Lore's verifiable tamper-evident source of truth
notes.interpretation: 對外宣傳語；本文用作 content hash 兼 integrity check 的根據，並支撐『cryptographic link 鎖住歷史』那段（連鎖失效細節在文中標為推斷）。

notes.quote: Lore is fully open source and released under an MIT license.
notes.interpretation: 授權資訊；結尾段使用。github README 亦載『MIT License』(n22) 互相佐證。

notes.quote: Maintained by Epic Games
notes.interpretation: 維護者；首句與結尾段使用。

notes.quote: The page lists SDKs in C/C++, C#, Rust, Go, Python, and JavaScript.
notes.interpretation: SDK 語言列表；結尾段使用。（此為 webfetch 對頁面的彙整描述，語言清單本身為事實。）

notes.quote: Every piece of content is stored once in an immutable, content-addressed data store keyed by BLAKE3 hashes.
notes.interpretation: content-addressed store 的核心句；H2『content-addressed store』開頭直引。

notes.quote: Deduplication is automatic: two clients producing the same bytes produce the same address and store one copy.
notes.interpretation: dedup 是寫入路徑內建性質；直引。

notes.quote: A complete address in the immutable store is the pair (hash, context) — 32 bytes for the BLAKE3 hash, 16 bytes for the context, 48 bytes total.
notes.interpretation: address 構造與 byte 數；直引（文中以『32 bytes for the BLAKE3 hash, 16 bytes for the context, 48 bytes total』片段引用）。

notes.quote: A context is a 16-byte opaque tag carried alongside a content hash... The motivating use is file identity.
notes.interpretation: context 的定義與用途（file identity）；文中引『a 16-byte opaque tag carried alongside a content hash』並述 file identity 用途。

notes.quote: they share a payload (deduplicated under the hood) but track different identities, with different version-control histories and different obliteration scopes.
notes.interpretation: 相同 hash 不同 context 視為不同 entity、payload 仍只一份；文中引前半句。

notes.quote: Lore uses BLAKE3, a 256-bit cryptographic hash, as its address function.
notes.interpretation: BLAKE3 256-bit；直引。選型理由（吞吐）在文中標為『合理的推測』。

notes.quote: The 256-bit output is large enough that collision risk is negligible across any plausible repository size.
notes.interpretation: 碰撞風險可忽略；直引。

notes.quote: Files larger than a threshold are split into chunks, content-defined via FastCDC or fixed-size depending on file type, so that a single edit inside a multi-gigabyte file re-uploads only the changed chunks and any byte range can be read without materializing the whole file.
notes.interpretation: chunking 的引入句（取代了原稿錯誤的『Files are stored as reusable chunks with indexed lookup』——該句不在來源中，已改為此 verbatim 句）。

notes.quote: A rolling hash slides over the file and a chunk boundary is placed wherever the hash matches a magic pattern, subject to minimum and maximum chunk sizes.
notes.interpretation: FastCDC 切點機制；直引。『只動少數 chunk』在文中標為推斷。

notes.quote: In the canonical implementation, FastCDC targets a 64 KiB average chunk with a 32 KiB floor and a 256 KiB ceiling; fixed-size chunking can be configured to any size up to that same 256 KiB ceiling.
notes.interpretation: FastCDC 預設參數與 fixed-size 上限；文中直引含 64/32/256 KiB。

notes.quote: Boundaries are placed at fixed offsets regardless of content.
notes.interpretation: fixed-size chunking 定義；直引。

notes.quote: Reusing prior boundaries preserves dedup but costs canonicality... the same content can therefore have multiple legitimate addresses.
notes.interpretation: CDC 的 canonicality 取捨；直引。

notes.quote: The address is canonical — one piece of content has exactly one address.
notes.interpretation: fixed-size 的 canonical address；文中引『The address is canonical—one piece of content has exactly one address』。『成本更低』判斷標為推斷。

notes.quote: If a fragment list exceeds the threshold, the list is itself chunked and stored as a fragment with a flag marking it as a list.
notes.interpretation: fragment list 遞迴 chunk；直引。『索引退化成樹』結論在文中標為推斷。

notes.quote: Identical regions across files dedupe.
notes.interpretation: 跨檔 dedup；直引。『省下儲存可觀』為合理外推、文中標明。

notes.quote: Each file node's hash derives from the file's content... Each directory node's hash derives from the sorted hash list of its children.
notes.interpretation: Merkle tree hash 推導規則；直引。

notes.quote: The root hash uniquely identifies the entire repository state.
notes.interpretation: root hash 唯一定義整庫狀態；直引。

notes.quote: Two revisions that differ in one file share every node not on the path from the root to that file, and 'share' here means the same hash, the same storage entry, no copy.
notes.interpretation: 改一檔僅重算路徑、其餘零複製；直引，圖與多段文使用。

notes.quote: Each revision references its parent or parents — one for an ordinary revision, two for a merge revision.
notes.interpretation: revision parent 引用；直引。

notes.quote: Revisions form a directed acyclic graph in which every edge is a cryptographic link.
notes.interpretation: revision DAG + cryptographic link；直引。tamper-evident 連鎖推論文中標為推斷。

notes.quote: A single logical source of truth must exist — for access control, durability, audit, and conflict resolution — but developers must still be able to work offline, queue revisions, and stage changes without a round-trip to the remote.
notes.interpretation: centrally-coordinated 性質與離線需求；H1 與 H2『centralized 但 offline-capable』直引。

notes.quote: Lore is centralized by design. Two clients communicate through the remote, not directly.
notes.interpretation: centralized by design 與 peer-to-peer non-goal；直引。

notes.quote: Centralized but offline-capable. The remote is the source of truth for durability, access control, and conflict resolution. Normal client operations (staging, committing, branching, switching, diffing) never require a round-trip.
notes.interpretation: 標題句『Centralized but offline-capable』與 never-require-round-trip；直引。

notes.quote: The immutable store holds content. Every byte that is ever written... goes here.
notes.interpretation: immutable store 責任；widget detail-1 與內文使用。

notes.quote: The mutable store holds pointers and names... anything that needs to be updated rather than appended to.
notes.interpretation: mutable store 責任；widget detail-2 與內文使用。

notes.quote: it is where consistency, serialization, and contention live.
notes.interpretation: mutable store 是 consistency/serialization/contention 所在；文中引『where consistency, serialization, and contention live』。

notes.quote: fragments are stored in packfiles — large append-only files, each holding many fragments back-to-back, with an index from address to offset.
notes.interpretation: packfiles 結構；widget detail-3 直引。打包動機在文中標為推斷。

notes.quote: A branch is a named, mutable pointer to a revision in this graph — the branch's latest revision, Lore's equivalent of Git's HEAD.
notes.interpretation: branch 是 mutable pointer、等同 Git HEAD；直引。（原稿『Lightweight branches...low-overhead without duplication』不在來源，已改寫為以此句為據、低成本論斷標為推斷。）

notes.quote: a latest pointer (most recent revision hash) and a metadata pointer
notes.interpretation: branch 只含兩個指標；直引。

notes.quote: The cas operation (compare-and-swap) is what gives Lore its atomic state transitions.
notes.interpretation: cas 提供 atomic state transition；直引。『rebase 後重試』流程在文中標為推斷。

notes.quote: look up the latest revision of a local branch, commit new revisions (advancing the local latest pointer), create or archive local branches, and diff against any locally cached revision.
notes.interpretation: 離線可做的操作清單；直引。

notes.quote: Clients hold only the data they actively use; the rest is fetched lazily from the remote — a deployment of one or more server processes with optional cache and replica tiers.
notes.interpretation: sparse+lazy 與部署形態；文中引前半句作 sparse 依據，後半句『a deployment of one or more server processes with optional cache and replica tiers』取代原稿不存在的『A service-backed architecture uses caching in front of durable storage...』。

notes.quote: Inbound filter declaring the sparse subset of the repository materialized to disk.
notes.interpretation: .lore/view 定義；直引。

notes.quote: Reading a byte range fetches only the fragments that overlap the range — typically a small fraction of the file.
notes.interpretation: byte-range hydration；直引。

notes.quote: They are large on every axis. File counts in the millions, individual files in the terabyte range, histories with millions of revisions, hundreds of branches per project, thousands of concurrent users, and hundreds of repositories sharing a single backend deployment.
notes.interpretation: 規模諸軸數字（百萬檔、TB 單檔、百萬 revision、數百 branch、數千並行使用者）；H1 與多段使用。

notes.quote: They are content-agnostic. A typical repository holds source code, build inputs, configuration, prebuilt artifacts, large data files, generated content, and arbitrary binary blobs.
notes.interpretation: content-agnostic 性質與內容清單；H1 直引依據。

notes.quote: multi-gigabyte files are still handled out of band via LFS rather than as first-class content; sparse checkout's sub-directory (file-pattern) granularity exists only in the deprecated non-cone mode
notes.interpretation: 對 Git 的批評（LFS out-of-band、sparse 僅 deprecated non-cone）；對照段直引。

notes.quote: Perforce requires server round-trips for normal operations: opening a file for edit, listing changes, syncing.
notes.interpretation: Perforce 需 server round-trip；對照段直引。

notes.quote: Storage is delta-encoded RCS for text and full-file for binaries... Offline work is possible but awkward
notes.interpretation: Perforce 儲存方式與離線『possible but awkward』；對照段引『delta-encoded RCS for text and full-file for binaries』與『possible but awkward』。

notes.quote: Lore is pre-1.0 and under active development. Interfaces, on-disk formats, and APIs may change between releases.
notes.interpretation: pre-1.0 警語；結尾 hedge 段直引。lore.org 首頁亦提出『Is Lore production-ready?』但未給答案，故以 github README 警語為據。

notes.quote: MIT License
notes.interpretation: 授權；與 n03 互證。
